src/domains/catalog.ts.name: Napplet catalog mock
src/domains/catalog.ts.description: Answers catalog lookups with the installed-napplet sample list, their identities, accepted intents and roles.

src/domains/class.ts.name: Security class mock
src/domains/class.ts.description: Assigns napplets a security class (strict default or user-approved origins) and records the two class posture documents.

src/domains/config.ts.name: Napplet settings mock
src/domains/config.ts.description: Accepts a napplet's settings schema, serves sample saved values, pushes updates and opens a pretend settings screen.

src/domains/connect.ts.name: Network grants mock
src/domains/connect.ts.description: Checks and normalizes allowed origins, simulates the consent gate and provides a pretend loopback network; there are no wire messages.

src/domains/inc.ts.name: Inter-napplet messaging entry
src/domains/inc.ts.description: Registry row only: the runtime routes napplet-to-napplet messages itself, so this just supplies a few sample topic strings.

src/domains/intent-fixtures.ts.name: Installed napplets sample
src/domains/intent-fixtures.ts.description: Three sample installed napplets shared by the intent and catalog mocks so both report the same identities and roles.

src/domains/intent.ts.name: Intents mock
src/domains/intent.ts.description: Finds which installed napplets can handle a request, invokes one, and pushes deliveries and availability changes.

src/domains/link.ts.name: Open link mock
src/domains/link.ts.description: Decides whether a link may open by its scheme and blocked-host rules, and records each decision.

src/domains/navigation.ts.name: Navigation mock
src/domains/navigation.ts.description: Keeps each window's reported page history and answers lookups, with controls to go back, forward or revisit an entry.

src/domains/notify.ts.name: Notifications mock
src/domains/notify.ts.description: Keeps active notifications, badges and channels, handles permission requests, and can simulate clicks, actions and dismissals.

src/domains/shell.ts.name: Shell registry entry
src/domains/shell.ts.description: Registry row only: shell readiness is answered by the shell package; lists the domains every mock shell should advertise.

src/domains/system.ts.name: System status mock
src/domains/system.ts.description: Reports pretend status of NAPs, services, relays, event cache, media and per-napplet storage, derived repeatably per window.

src/domains/theme.ts.name: Theme mock
src/domains/theme.ts.description: Serves a light and a dark sample theme and pushes a change message when the theme is switched.

src/domains/worker.ts.name: Background worker mock
src/domains/worker.ts.description: Creates pretend background workers within limits, passes messages to them and pushes messages, errors and close reasons.
